name: default
description: Progress toward the checkpoint along a drivable path (+0.1 per px closer when driving forward, nothing while reversing, -0.1 per px farther), +500 per checkpoint, -100 per wall contact (even a harmless bump), -1000 for a full loss of health (a 25 % hit costs -250), -3000 for a wreck, and -0.25 per step stopped (-30/s). Game points don't count: they're the score, not the lesson.
